steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to this Gitea instance: click the Sign In link/button, enter username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} exactly as that text, submit, and verify you are signed in as admin. Report what you see on the dashboard.

02-open: Go to the repository {{01-signin.repository_list}}, then open its Issues list (only OPEN issues, not closed). Report the exact titles of every open issue whose title starts with 'Seed:', exactly as displayed. Also report the total number of open issues and their numbers. Do not modify anything.

03-create: In the repository {{01-signin.repository_list}}, create a new issue with the exact title '{{runid}} Bench Issue' and a description (markdown text area) that includes the text '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Bench issue created for run {{runid}}.'). Submit it and verify the issue page opens. Report the issue's number as displayed (like #4), its title, and its description text. Do not set labels, assignee or milestone yet.

04-set: On the issue page {{03-create.url}} (titled '{{runid}} Bench Issue'), use the sidebar Labels picker to set exactly two labels: 'bug' and 'priority-high'. Make sure the app applies them and the issue page shows exactly the labels 'bug' and 'priority-high' (and no others) in the sidebar. Report the exact list of labels shown on the issue after applying.

05-report: On the issue page {{03-create.url}} (titled '{{runid}} Bench Issue'), use the sidebar Assignees picker to assign the issue to the user 'bench-assignee'. Make sure the app applies it and the issue page shows 'bench-assignee' as the assignee in the sidebar. Report the exact assignee name shown on the issue after applying.

06-set: On the issue page {{03-create.url}} (titled '{{runid}} Bench Issue'), use the sidebar Milestone picker to set the issue's milestone to 'Bench Milestone'. Make sure the app applies it and the issue page shows 'Bench Milestone' as the milestone in the sidebar. Report the exact milestone name shown on the issue after applying, and confirm the labels ({{04-set.labels_shown_on_issue}}) and assignee (bench-assignee) are still present.

07-add: On the issue page {{03-create.url}} (titled '{{runid}} Bench Issue'), add a comment using the markdown comment text area at the bottom, with text that includes '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Comment for run {{runid}}.'). Submit it and verify the comment appears on the issue page. Report the exact comment text shown, and confirm the issue still shows labels bug and priority-high, assignee bench-assignee, and milestone Bench Milestone.

08-open: Final verification, read-only, do not modify anything. Open {{03-create.url}} and report: (a) the issue's number exactly as displayed (e.g. #4) and its title, (b) the exact list of labels shown in the sidebar, (c) the assignee shown, (d) the milestone shown, (e) the description text, (f) whether any comment on the page contains the text '{{runid}}' and its text. Then open the open-issues list for {{01-signin.repository_list}} and report the exact titles of open issues starting with 'Seed:' to confirm they are unchanged.
